clips.title: Two agents, one task
clips.caption: Type the task once, pick Claude Code and Codex, and each starts in its own worktree with the task as its first prompt.

clips.title: Every pane at a glance
clips.caption: Worktrees in the sidebar, a mark per pane; the + menu adds a terminal or Claude Code, and the panes share the room.

clips.title: Stage, commit, publish, review
clips.caption: One hunk staged, then Commit All, Publish branch and Open review from the Changes tab.

clips.title: The pane that needs you
clips.caption: claude asks before editing; the dot and the All panes board say so until you answer, then it finishes.

clips.title: Quit, relaunch, carry on
clips.caption: Recorded shell output stays above a fresh shell; the file tabs return and Codex resumes its conversation.

clips.title: Open anything
clips.caption: ⌘P opens a code file, a markdown page and an image in the file column beside the terminal.
